about: How the CDC Race & Ethnicity codes OpenEMR keeps in list_options.notes roll up to FPAR 2.0's five race columns and its ethnicity. The code ranges are the UDS Report module's (data/race-ethnicity.json, checked against the 921 coded entries of OpenEMR's race list): a code's first four digits fall in a group's range. A code in no range, such as 2131-1 Other Race, is race not known. Each column's code is OPA's current CDCREC value for it (data/fpar2.json).
terms: CC0 1.0: our own mapping. CDC Race & Ethnicity codes are public (CDC PHIN VADS).
